from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
import re

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/435-36/1_435-36_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/435-36_0_0c7004c3/1_435-36_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def norm_badge(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    s = str(value).strip()
    if s.endswith(".0"):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

def is_centered(cell):
    return (cell.alignment.horizontal or "").lower() == "center"

def is_right_aligned(cell):
    return (cell.alignment.horizontal or "").lower() == "right"

# Build lookup of correct rows: same badge number, badge cell centered
correct_by_badge = {}
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    badge = norm_badge(ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value)
    if badge and is_centered(ws.cell(row=row, column=3)):
        correct_by_badge[badge] = {
            "Name": ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value,
            "Group": ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value,
            "Manager": ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value,
        }

# Only modify the allowed highlighted range: C5:F13
for row in range(5, 14):
    badge_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=3)
    badge = norm_badge(badge_cell.value)

    if badge in correct_by_badge:
        correct = correct_by_badge[badge]

        # Preserve badge number in column C; update only related fields within C5:F13
        ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = correct["Name"]
        ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = correct["Group"]
        ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value = correct["Manager"]

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
